headline: Executive order bans certain imports from Russia and certain new U.S. investments, citing Russia's actions against Ukraine.
what_it_does: This executive order blocks certain goods from Russia from being brought into the United States. It also bars certain new investments by Americans. It was issued in response to Russia's efforts against Ukraine's independence and borders. The title alone does not say which goods or investments are covered.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. importers who buy goods from Russia
who_it_affects.how: They may no longer be allowed to bring certain Russian products into the United States.
They may be barred from making certain new investments tied to Russia.

who_it_affects.group: Russian businesses that sell to the U.S.
who_it_affects.how: They may lose access to the U.S. market for the covered products.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 8, 2022; the exact start date is not stated in the title.
